projects.name: Dāren Ford lead
projects.summary: Mårék and Aren are on journey day 2 west from Valek toward Dāren Ford, following both the earlier strange-person rumor and the newly recovered Orren / Varek leads.
projects.current_state: Dāren Ford remains unvisited. Earlier road information put it roughly 3–4 days by road from Valek; the current trip is not yet close enough to arrive today.

projects.name: Orren Vask delivery
projects.summary: Orren Vask's abandoned wagon was found west of Hareth Rest. His chest, ledger, medicine, fittings, and sealed packets were recovered from thieves.
projects.current_state: Orren's last known state is that he fled wounded into brush after the robbery three days earlier. Mårék intends to try to complete Orren's Dāren delivery in his honor if possible; Orren is not confirmed dead.

projects.name: Rask / Varek stolen-goods thread
projects.summary: Rask led repeat road robberies and used caches and fences. Kerr identified Varek as a more important buyer near Dāren Ford and associated him with the three-lines-under-a-curve mark.
projects.current_state: Rask is dead. Varek's true role and the mark's meaning remain unresolved. A hidden note points to Dāren Ford's south ferry yard after sunset and says to ask for Meln.

projects.name: Kareth outer wall
projects.summary: The former new front defensive line became a substantial outer wall during Mårék's 337-day absence. The old wall remains as an inner defensive line.
projects.current_state: Established as part of current Kareth rather than an unfinished proposed line.

projects.name: Kareth–Quarry haul road
projects.summary: The quarry route is now a regularly used worked haul road with major hazards reduced and drainage improved.
projects.current_state: Operational. The quarry's old dark low-bodied creature threat has not yet been rechecked after the 337-day absence.

projects.name: Avelin relocation
projects.summary: Avelin relocated to the former cairn-marked candidate site and remains a separate walled settlement with its own people, leadership, fields, and livestock.
projects.current_state: The Kareth–Avelin alliance held through Mårék's absence and a maintained road now connects them.

projects.name: Quarry threat reassessment
projects.summary: The dark low-bodied creature threat at the Kareth Quarry was unresolved before Mårék's 337-day absence.
projects.current_state: Its present status is unknown; no post-return recheck has yet been established.
